column1: #Insert size from the overlap of read 1 with the reverse complement of read 2 (fastp's overlap analysis: at least 30 overlapping bases, at most 5 mismatches and 20 % of the overlap). Pairs without an overlap have an insert longer than the two reads together or too many differences; they are in the last bin with inserts of 512 or more.

#Adapter read-through: the insert is shorter than read 1, so the reads continue into the adapter (to be trimmed). The adapter of each read is the consensus of the bases after the insert; adapter dimers are pairs whose read 1 begins with it (12 bases, at most 1 mismatch).
